title: 동아리 가입: 모임은 언제 한다고 들었어요?
objective: Ask about meetings and fees with -다고 들었어요.
summary: A student asks a club about meetings and fees.
setting: A club recruitment booth on campus at the start of the semester. Mark, an international student, talks to a member of the photography club.

task.title: Practice joining a club
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expression list to fill in, choose, check and write your answers.

words.exampleMeaning: About how many clubs are there at the school?
Please be sure to write your contact number on the form.
Who should I pay the club fee to?

words.example: 악기가 없으면 동아리 걸 빌려 써도 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you don't have an instrument, you can borrow the club's.
I heard the welcome party for new students is on Friday.

dialogue.korean: 사진 동아리에 관심 있어요? 사진은 보통 뭘로 찍어요?
dialogue.meaning: Are you interested in the photography club? What do you usually take photos with?

dialogue.korean: 휴대폰으로만 찍어요. 카메라가 없어도 가입할 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I only take them with my phone. Can I join even if I don't have a camera?

dialogue.korean: 그럼요. 동아리 카메라도 빌려 쓸 수 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Of course. You can also borrow the club's cameras.

dialogue.korean: 다행이네요. 그런데 모임은 매주 한다고 들었어요. 무슨 요일이에요?
dialogue.meaning: That's a relief. By the way, I heard you meet every week. What day is it?
We meet in the club room every Thursday evening.
Do I have to pay a membership fee too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 학기마다 회비가 있어요. 자세한 건 이 신청서에 나와 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there's a fee every semester. The details are on this application form.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the right quoting form (-는다고, -ㄴ다고, -다고, -(이)라고): ① 그 동아리는 연습이 (힘들다) ____ 들었어요. ② 동아리 회장이 경영학과 (학생이다) ____ 들었어요.
Choose the right word (신청서 / 회비 / 빌려): ① 가입하려면 이 ____에 이름과 학과를 쓰세요. ② 학기가 시작되면 ____를 내야 해요. ③ 기타가 없으면 동아리 기타를 ____ 써도 돼요.
Read the dialogue and write True or False: ① 마크는 카메라가 있어요. ② 동아리는 목요일 저녁에 모여요. ③ 이 동아리는 회비가 없어요.
Answer in Korean: A friend told you the badminton club practices every Wednesday. Tell the club member what you heard, then ask what time it starts.
answers: ① 신청서 ② 회비 ③ 빌려
① False ② True ③ False
배드민턴 동아리는 매주 수요일에 연습한다고 들었어요. 몇 시에 시작해요? (수요일마다 연습한다고 들었어요. 몇 시부터 해요?)
